pull.title: Refactor more class variables to accessors and delegators
pull.body:
### Motivation / Background

This Pull Request has been created because `@@variables` class variables aren't ractor safe in Ruby 4.0.6, but they are on edge Ruby.

### Detail

This Pull Request changes `mattr_accessor` usage to plain old `attr_accessor`s so they may be referenced safely on Ractors today.

### Checklist

Before submitting the PR make sure the following are checked:

* [x] This Pull Request is related to one change. Unrelated changes should be opened in separate PRs.
* [x] Commit message has a detailed description of what changed and why. If this PR fixes a related issue include it in the commit message. Ex: `[Fix #issue-number]`
* [x] Tests are added or updated if you fix a bug or add a feature.
* [ ] CHANGELOG files are updated for the changed libraries if there is a behavior change or additional feature. Minor bug fixes and documentation changes should not be included.

commit.message:
Store prepend_content_exfiltration_prevention in a singleton class attribute

The setting was a class variable, which non-main Ractors cannot read
on Ruby 4.0.

Store the ActionDispatch::Http::URL settings in singleton class attributes

tld_length, secure_protocol, and domain_extractor were class variables,
which non-main Ractors cannot read on Ruby 4.0.

Store the FormTagHelper settings in singleton class attributes

default_enforce_utf8 and embed_authenticity_token_in_remote_forms were
class variables, which non-main Ractors cannot read on Ruby 4.0.

Store ActionView::Base.default_form_builder in a singleton class attribute

The setting was a class variable, which non-main Ractors cannot read
on Ruby 4.0. It is only read through ActionView::Base, so a singleton
class attribute is enough.

Store the FormHelper settings in singleton class attributes

form_with_generates_remote_forms, form_with_generates_ids, and
multiple_file_field_include_hidden were class variables, which
non-main Ractors cannot read on Ruby 4.0.

Store button_to_generates_button_tag in a singleton class attribute

The setting was a class variable, which non-main Ractors cannot read
on Ruby 4.0.
